title: Norvik Analytics raises $45M Series B led by Halcyon Ventures
description: Oslo-based Norvik Analytics, which sells demand forecasting software to retailers, has raised a $45 million Series B led by Halcyon Ventures, with participation from existing investor Fjord Capital.
extra_snippets: The round brings Norvik Analytics' total funding to $61 million.
CEO Ingrid Solberg said the money will fund expansion into Germany and the UK.

title: Norvik Analytics names former Klarna executive as CFO
description: Norvik Analytics has hired a new chief financial officer as it prepares for international expansion.

title: Robotics startup Norvik Labs raises $30M from Brightline Partners
description: Norvik Labs, a Gothenburg warehouse robotics company unrelated to Norvik Analytics, raised $30 million led by Brightline Partners.

title: Norvik Analytics closes $12M Series A led by Fjord Capital
description: Retail forecasting startup Norvik Analytics raised a $12 million Series A led by Fjord Capital.
